summary: Pilot-only exploration of screen candidates and GBM settings via nested CV
reasoning: Pilot-only exploration to choose the screen and GBM settings. Building on step-7 (inherited leaky F30+LR: cv 0.761 vs holdout 0.5639, so a fixed F-top-k screen carries selection-overfit risk) and step-19 (RF on 30 features selected inside CV cleared the floor with agreement, suggesting importance/bagged screens are more reliable than plain F-top-k). I will write two scripts, run both with uv, inspect printed diagnostics, and choose the screen + GBM grid for the locked procedure. This run touches pilot only; heldout is not opened. Expected in reasoning (not yet a claimed milestone): individual feature signals are modest (OOF AUC ~0.55-0.70), best screen+GBM nested CV lands >= 0.70 with a modest leak-bias; if nothing reaches 0.70 on pilot, that changes the route's feasibility and I will reassess before any heldout scoring.
